name: Russian Battlecruiser Pyotr Velikiy
description: Peter the Great is a nuclear-powered missile cruiser of the Russian Navy. It is the fourth ship of the Soviet Type 1144 (NATO: Kirov-class) cruiser. It is known as the pinnacle of the former Soviet Navy and has the most advanced and complete combat system at the time. It has a total length of 252 meters, a width of 28.5 meters, a standard displacement of 19,000 tons, and a full load displacement of 24,300 tons. It is the largest non-aircraft carrier combat ship in the world and the only non-aircraft carrier nuclear-powered surface combat ship in active service in the world. It is mainly used to conduct ocean-going anti-ship, anti-submarine and air defense operations.
